spans.s: उष्ण (I) a. (f. ष्णा) 1. Hot, warm, R.xii.4; 2. sharp, strict, active, आददे नातिशीतोष्णो नभस्वानिव दक्षिणः R.iv.8 (where the word is used in both the senses.); 3. pungent; 4. clever.
उष्ण (II) m.n. 1. Heat, warmth; 2. the hot reason (ग्रीष्म); 3. sunshine.
उष्ण (III) m. An onion.
